_comment: What this library is called in {{Lang}}. Values are LOAD-BEARING: they become published package and module names, which are permanent public API. Every top-level submodule is a naming decision — test/profile.test.js fails until each is recorded, which is what makes the decision deliberate rather than silently derived.

aws-cdk-lib._submodulePrefix: aws-cdk-lib names its submodules aws_<service> while the conventional import alias leaves the prefix off (aws_iam -> iam). That is a fact about this library, so it is declared here rather than assumed by the target.
